title: CHIP - federal/state framework
facts: CHIP is a joint federal-state program providing health coverage primarily to uninsured children in families whose incomes are too high for Medicaid but who meet their state's CHIP rules.
CHIP eligibility levels vary by state and can also include certain pregnant populations depending on state options.
States may operate CHIP as a separate program, a Medicaid expansion, or a combination of both.
Specific CHIP income limits, premiums, cost sharing and enrollment details require current state program information.
